Rows in exact order, each row exactly 8 frames:
1: first 4 idle breathing blink, next 4 recoil hurt and recovery.
2: 8 consecutive walking cycle frames heel contact, compression, passing, lifting, opposite leg contact, compression, passing, lifting; clear alternating legs and swinging arms.
3: 8 running cycle frames lean forward, strong counter-swing, compact airborne legs, land alternating feet.
4: 8 jump frames crouch takeoff, rising, tucked rising, apex, extending fall, down fall, crouched landing, standing recovery.
5: 8 diagonal sword-slash unarmed grip poses: guard, gather, weapon hand behind upper-left shoulder, decisive forward-down strike at frame 4, follow low right, recoil, return, guard.
6: 8 rising slash: guard, low gather, deepest low, decisive up-right strike frame 4, high extension, recoil, return, guard.
7: 8 overhead heavy slash: guard, gather raised arms, fully above head, forward downward strike frame 4, low followthrough, recoil, return, guard.
8: 8 archer poses without bow: ready, bow hand extends right, back hand pulls to cheek, arrow release at frame 4 with FRONT palm right at chest height, release recovery, relax, return, ready.
9: 8 mage poses without staff: ready, gather staff hand, raise hand, thrust front hand right at frame 4 chest height, full cast extension, relax, return, ready.
Each row maintains body size; feet baseline consistent except airborne running and jumping. Completely transparent alpha. Important: EXACTLY 8 columns x9 rows, never combine characters or overlap cells.
